formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c : Point) (AB : Line) (h1 : distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) (h2 : formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AB) : ∃ b' c' : Point, |(a─b')| = |(b──c)| ∧ |(a─c')| = |(c──b)| := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (f : Point) (g : Point) (AB : Line) (DC : Line) (EF : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle d c e DC EF) ∧ (a ≠ d)) → (∃ (F G : Point) (FAG : Line), (formRectilinearAngle a F G FAG) ∧ (Line.intersectsLine FAG AB) ∧ (∠ a:F:G = ∠ d:c:e))
formalizations.full_output: theorem thm33 (a b c d e f g : Point) (AB DC EF : Line) (h1 : distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) (h2 : formRectilinearAngle d c e DC EF) (h3 : a ≠ d) : ∃ (F G : Point) (FAG : Line), (formRectilinearAngle a F G FAG) ∧ (Line.intersectsLine FAG AB) ∧ (∠ a:F:G = ∠ d:c:e) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (AE : Line) (BF : Line) (CE : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE) ∧ (a ≠ b)) → (∃ f g : Point, formRectilinearAngle f a g AE BF ∧ ∠ f:a:g = ∠ d:c:e)

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (f : Point) (g : Point) (h : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (CE : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle c d e CD CE) ∧ (formTriangle a b c AB CD CE)) → (∃ f g e : Point, (formParallelogram a b e f AB CE CD) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle a b e AB CE) ∧ (∠ a:b:e = ∠ c:d:e))

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d e : Point) (AB CD CE : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ formRectilinearAngle d c e CD CE → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ f:a:b = ∠ d:c:e)
nl_statement: To construct a rectilinear angle equal to a given rectilinear angle at a (given) point on a given straight-line.Let $AB$ be the given straight-line,  $A$ the (given) point on it, and  $DCE$ the given rectilinear angle.So it is required to construct a rectilinear angle equal to the given rectilinear angle $DCE$ at the (given) point $A$ on the given straight-line $AB$.  <prf> Thus, the rectilinear angle $FAG$,  equal to the  given rectilinear angle $DCE$, has been constructed at the (given) point $A$ on the given straight-line $AB$.
